multiplicity_control.source_excerpt: 2.5.2 co-primary testing and 2.6.2 testing strategy: "The co-primary endpoints are PASI 75 response and IGA 0 or 1 response at Week 12." "The hypotheses and will both be tested at level 2.5% (one-sided), and significant results" "will only be achieved if both tests are rejected." "As stated in Section 2.5.2, the hypotheses H1 and H2 will be included in co-primary testing" "Each hypotheses is tested at α = 2.5% (one-sided)." "have been rejected at α (one-sided) such that a family-wise type-I-error of α (one-sided) is kept." -- The co-primary hypotheses are tested together: superiority is concluded only if both are rejected. PASI 90 at Week 12 is tested only after both co-primary tests reject, preserving family-wise one-sided alpha. Alpha values convert the source's 2.5% to 0.025. No additional fixed sequence for other secondary endpoints is stated. SAP finalization status is not asserted.

study_schedule.source_excerpt: 3 Study design and Table 8-1 assessment schedule: "• Screening Period (of at least 1 week and up to 4 weeks between Screening and" "The screening period is used to assess eligibility of the subjects and to taper subjects off" "• Treatment Period 1 (of 12 weeks, double-blind between Randomization and Week 12 pre-" "• Treatment Period 2 (of 40 weeks, double-blind between Week 12 dosing and Week 52)" "Week 52 is the planned End of Treatment Period 2/End of Study (EOT2/EOS)." "study sites (Table 8-1) once weekly at Randomization, Weeks 1, 2, and 3, followed by dosing" "study sites or at home (Table 8-1) every four weeks starting at Week 12 up to Week 48:" "(Table 8-1) once weekly at Weeks 13, 14 and 15:" "Table 8-1 Assessment schedule" "Week (relative to 52b" "12a" "Randomization) ≤ -4 Rg 1 2 3 4 8 13 14 15 16 20 i" "24 i" "28 32 i" "36 i" "40 44 i" "48 i" "EOT2/" "EOT1" "EOS" "to R 8 15 22 29 57 85 92 99 106 113 141 169 197 225 253 281 309 337 365" "i Study treatment will be self-administered at home at Weeks 20, 24, 32, 36, 44, and 48, and at study site for all other visits." -- Screening lasts at least 1 and up to 4 weeks; its table window is Days -28 to -7. Treatment Period 1 runs from randomization to the Week 12 pre-dose assessment. Treatment Period 2 runs from Week 12 dosing to Week 52. The scheduled assessment table includes the listed visit weeks, with randomization at Week 0. Subjects stopping treatment early have an end-of-treatment visit approximately 4 weeks after their last dose; that conditional visit is not a routine follow-up period. Week 52 is the planned end of treatment and study.

published_results.source_excerpt: 14.1 Adult Plaque Psoriasis, Table: Clinical outcomes at Week 12, Trial PsO7 column: "300 mg/2 mL Pre-filled Syringe and 300 mg/2 mL UnoReady Pen Two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 52-week trials (PsO6 and PsO7) enrolled 336 subjects at least 18 years of age with moderate to severe PsO who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy to evaluate the safety and efficacy of COSENTYX 300 mg subcutaneously administered with a single 300 mg/2 mL prefilled syringe (Trial PsO6, NCT02748863, 214 patients) or with a single 300 mg/2 mL UnoReady pen (Trial PsO7, NCT03589885, 122 patients) compared to two subcutaneous injections using a 150 mg/1 mL prefilled syringe." "The co-primary endpoints for both trials were the proportion of subjects who achieved a PASI 75 response and IGA mod 2011 ‘clear’ or ‘almost clear’ response with at least a two-grade reduction from baseline at Week 12." "Trial PsO6 Trial PsO7 COSENTYX 300 mg COSENTYX 300 mg 2 mL PFS (N = 72) % Two 1 mL PFS (N = 71) % Placebo (N = 71) % 2 mL Pen (N = 41) % Two 1 mL PFS (N = 41) % Placebo (N = 40) % IGA of clear or almost clear 76 69 1 76 68 8 PASI 75 response 89 82 2 95 83 10 PASI 90 response 67 70 2 76 62 5 14.2 Pediatric Plaque Psoriasis A 52-week, multicenter randomized, double-blind, placebo and active-controlled trial (Trial PsO8; NCT02471144) enrolled 162 pediatric subjects 6 years of age and older, with severe plaque psoriasis (as defined by a PASI score ≥ 20, an IGA modified 2011 score of 4, and involving ≥ 10% of the BSA) who were candidates for systemic therapy." -- Trial mapping: label Trial PsO7 is explicitly NCT03589885 (122 patients), matching CT.gov acronym MATURE and protocol CAIN457A2325. The table headers give PsO7 denominators 41, 41, and 40 for 2 mL pen, two 1 mL PFS, and placebo. Label values are percentages in Table 5: 95/83/10 for PASI 75 and 76/68/8 for IGA clear/almost clear. The primary endpoint timepoint is Week 12, in the double-blind period before placebo switching. Percentages are copied as printed; responder counts are not back-calculated.
